piezas.titulo: Reading comprehension: Schedules, appointments and weekly routine
texto: Contextual reading of a weekly schedule and a confirmation email: read the dialogue in which two colleagues coordinate their work duties and their medical visits according to the weekly timetable. Notice how tasks already finished («เสร็จแล้ว») are contrasted with future commitments («จะไป»).

pregunta.texto: Reading comprehension: According to the text, which idea does the sentence «ช่วงเวลาบ่ายมักเป็นเวลาที่เหมาะสมสำหรับการประชุมและติดตามความคืบหน้า» express?

opciones.texto: The early afternoon is ideal for follow-up meetings.
opciones.explicacion: Correct: this option translates and accurately interprets the sentence «ช่วงเวลาบ่ายมักเป็นเวลาที่เหมาะสมสำหรับการประชุมและติดตามความคืบหน้า» from the text.

opciones.texto: Noting tasks in a diary prevents oversights and unexpected forgetfulness.
opciones.explicacion: Incorrect: this is another statement from the passage, not the meaning of the sentence in question.

opciones.texto: Setting aside leisure time at the weekend restores physical and mental energy.
opciones.explicacion: Incorrect: this option corresponds to another sentence in the reading passage.

pregunta.texto: According to the conversation you read, what commitment does Mali have tomorrow morning?

opciones.texto: Will go to see the doctor (จะไปพบหมอ)
opciones.explicacion: Correct: Mali explicitly states «พรุ่งนี้เช้าฉันจะไปพบหมอค่ะ».

opciones.texto: Will have to travel to another province
opciones.explicacion: Incorrect: it does not mention any trip to another province.

opciones.texto: Will exercise in the park all morning
opciones.explicacion: Incorrect: her morning appointment is a medical one.

pregunta.texto: Read the sentence and choose its meaning.
